verdict.rationale: The evidence documents webhooks, which send an HTTP POST to a URL when events occur, such as an AI note being generated or an action item being completed. That is an event-delivery building block: the developer must build the rule logic and resulting actions externally. No in-product rules or automation engine is documented for defining conditions that trigger actions inside Fellow, so the webhooks earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
